payload.title: Verify catalog effects across preview and export
payload.description:
## Behavior
As a maintainer, I can catch visual regressions before publishing effects.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given pinned browser/fonts/assets/seeds, when representative frames and short clips are generated, then sequential, random-seek, and parallel-worker results are compared with recorded tolerances. Compare player preview and export at boundaries and overlaps, and record performance/resource measurements without unmeasured claims. Baseline updates require intentional review.

## Ownership
toolchain, videoml-org, player; Babulus integration

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
